description: Offline word-sense disambiguation for .NET: the English word lexicon (lemma, part of speech, features) with the Open English WordNet sense and group catalog, the model contract (IWordSenseModel) with result types, and a built-in statistical model (a part-of-speech tagger and context cues, no neural network) that answers every word in context at the part-of-speech level, with no model download and no ONNX dependency. Add DemaConsulting.WordSense.MiniLM or .BertBaseCased for the fine senses of the common words.
title: WordSense
